_comment: Section 10 (spare parts) tunables. See docs/REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md §13 for how every formula here was verified against the reference DOCX using the client's spare-parts logistics export.
_period_field_comment: Which date column anchors a row to a reporting period. Verified: 'Дата отправки заказа' (order dispatch date) is the ONLY one of the three candidate date columns that reproduces the reference's exact figures (746 rows / 709 orders / 756 items / leader part 'Y010123-000232-01V'=24 pcs) when the window is the CURRENT + PREVIOUS month combined -- see below.
_period_window_comment: Section 10's headline figures and its 10.1 table cover a TWO-month window (current + calendar-previous), not just the current month -- confirmed exactly against the reference (321 June rows + 425 July rows = 746 total). This mirrors the 2-column month layout of the 10.1 table itself.
_line_status_order_comment: Fixed display order for section 10.1's status rows, verified against the reference table (alphabetical, which this list already is). A status value present in the data but NOT in this list is still shown -- appended after these, sorted alphabetically -- rather than silently dropped, so a future new status doesn't disappear from the report.
_shipped_status_comment: Section 10.2's 'Отгружено' column counts rows whose line_status equals this value. Cross-checked against an alternative definition (shipped_qty > 0) on a sample city and both agreed exactly, so the simpler status-based definition is used.
